blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly non-linear components, in this work we demonstrate that they exhibit fundamental linearity: when inputs from distinct text streams are linearly combined, the model outputs a superposition of the individual next-token distributions. We term this the Superposition Linearity Hypothesis . We provide evidence that superposition is an intrinsic property of the Transformer architecture rather than an emergent consequence of training; in fact, we observe that it tends to diminish as pretraining progresses. However, we demonstrate that linearity can be substantially restored through lightweight fine-tuning, significantly reducing the divergence between the predicted next-token distribution and the average of the individual next-token distributions. Finally, we introduce a guided decoding procedure that disentangles superposed outputs, enabling the simultaneous generation of two coherent continuations from a single forward pass.
blocks.zh: 虽然大语言模型(LLMs)依赖高度非线性组件,但我们在这项工作中证明了它们表现出了基本的线性:当来自不同文本流的输入线性结合时,模型输出了单个下位子分布的叠加. 我们称之为超位线性假设 我们提供证据表明,叠加是变形器结构的内在属性,而不是培训的紧急后果;事实上,我们观察到,随着预训练的进展,叠加往往会减少。 然而,我们表明,通过轻量级微调,线性可以大大恢复,大大缩小了预测的邻接式分布与单个邻接式分布平均值之间的差距。 最后,我们采用了一种有指导的解码程序,将叠加的产出分解开来,从而能够同时从单一的前进通道产生两个连贯的延续。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Transformer architecture Vaswani et al. (2017) underlies modern Large Language Models (LLMs) and is built from highly non-linear components, including self-attention and MLP blocks with non-linear activations. The prevailing paradigm therefore treats inference as a single coherent semantic stream: to process multiple independent streams one typically runs separate forward passes, performs sequential processing, or modifies the architecture to avoid destructive interference between inputs.
blocks.zh: 变形金刚建筑Vaswani等人(2017年)是现代大语言模型(LLMS)的基础,由高度非线性组件构成,包括具有非线性激活功能的自觉和MLP块. 因此,流行的范式将推论视为一个单一的连贯语义流:处理多个独立流,通常会分流前传,进行顺序处理,或修改架构以避免输入之间的破坏性干扰.

blocks.en: At the same time, recent work shows that, despite these non-linearities, decoder-only Transformers exhibit strong linear structure in the residual stream: transitions between consecutive layers can often be well-approximated by affine maps Razzhigaev et al. (2024) . This motivates a natural question: does such linearity extend beyond layer-to-layer geometry to the model’s end-to-end input–output behavior? Specifically, are the computations sufficiently linear that the response to a linear combination of inputs approximates a corresponding combination of their independent outputs?
blocks.zh: 同时,近期的作品显示,尽管这些非线性,但只有解码器的变形器在残流中表现出强烈的线性结构:连续层之间的过渡往往可以被近似于affine地图Razzigaev等人(2024年). 这引发了一个自然的问题:这种线性是否超越层到层几何到模型的端到端输入-输出行为? 具体来说,这些计算是否足够线性,以至于对输入的线性组合的反应大约是其独立输出的相应组合?

blocks.en: We formalize this as the Superposition Linearity Hypothesis : when two token streams with embeddings 𝐱 A \mathbf{x}_{A} and 𝐱 B \mathbf{x}_{B} are linearly combined (here, via element-wise averaging), the model processes the mixture as a superposition of the two pathways. Empirically, when embeddings from two distinct documents are averaged token-wise and passed through standard pre-trained LLMs, the next-token predictions associated with both streams consistently retain substantial mass in the mixed distribution; in particular, the ground-truth next tokens for both streams frequently appear within the top-10 ranks of the combined output distribution (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们将此正式化为超位线性假说: 当两个嵌入的符号流 x 一个 \ mathbf{ x}_{A} 和 x B\ mathbf{ x}_{} B}是线性结合的(在此,通过元素平均),模型将混合物作为两种途径的叠加处理。 经验是,如果从两个不同文件中嵌入的符号是平均的,并且通过标准事先训练的LLMS,那么与两个流有关的下一批预测在混合分布中始终保持相当的质量;特别是,两个流的地真相下一批符号经常出现在合并产出分布的10个级别(图1)。

blocks.en: To distinguish architectural bias from learned capability, we track this phenomenon across the pre-training trajectory. We find that superposition fidelity is maximized at initialization and gradually diminishes as the model optimizes the language modeling objective, indicating that linear superposition is intrinsic to the architecture rather than a capability acquired through learning. We further observe a strong correlation between geometric linearity in hidden states (measured via feature additivity) and rank preservation under superposition.
blocks.zh: 为了区分建筑上的偏差和学习的能力,我们通过训练前的轨迹追踪这一现象。 我们发现,超位忠贞在初始化时被最大化,随着模型优化语言建模目标而逐渐减弱,表明线性超位是架构的内在,而不是通过学习获得的能力. 我们进一步观察到,隐藏状态(通过特征加成度衡量)的几何线性与叠加状态下的保级之间有着很强的关联。

blocks.en: Although pre-training degrades this property, we show it can be substantially restored via a lightweight fine-tuning phase using less than 0.025 % 0.025\% of the original pre-training dataset size. Leveraging the amplified linearity, we then propose a decoding procedure that disentangles the mixed hidden state, enabling recovery of the distinct continuations corresponding to the original input texts from a single mixed forward pass.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We demonstrate that standard pre-trained LLMs retain high probability mass on the same tokens favored by the respective independent distributions. • We show that superposition linearity is an intrinsic architectural property and tends to degrade during pre-training, rather than a capability acquired through the learning process. • We show that the degraded linearity can be substantially recovered using minimal fine-tuning. • We develop a decoding mechanism to disentangle the mixed output distribution back into its constituent text streams.

blocks.en: Our results reveal that the Transformer architecture possesses a surprising degree of intrinsic linearity. Despite the destructive interference inherent in averaging high-dimensional feature vectors, the ground-truth tokens survive the mixing process with high frequency. Specifically, across these architectures (represented by solid lines in the figure): • In approximately 30–40% of cases, the true token appears within the top-10 ranks. • In 50–60% of cases, the true token is found within the top-50 ranks. • By the top-100 ranks, the recovery rate reaches upwards of 60–65% . Considering the large vocabulary sizes ( | 𝒱 | ≥ 50,000 |\mathcal{V}|\geq 50,000 ), these results indicate that the “signal” from the original inputs is preserved well above the noise floor. The mixed state does not collapse into gibberish; rather, it effectively narrows down the search space to a small neighborhood containing the valid continuations for both constituent contexts.

blocks.en: 3 An attention-patching analysis
blocks.zh: 3个 注意射击分析

blocks.en:
The linear superposition demonstrated in Section 2 is counter-intuitive. Key components of the Transformer, particularly self-attention with its softmax non-linearity, are designed to integrate context selectively. One would expect the attention patterns from two unrelated streams (A and B) to interfere destructively, causing the mixed representation to collapse into a state unrelated to either input. Yet, empirically, the signal survives.
This raises the question: does attention play a role in enabling this linearity, or is it a barrier that the residual stream somehow bypasses? To investigate, we design an experiment that disentangles the influence of attention’s structural shape from its content-specific computations. We compare our standard embedding mixing setup against two single-stream perturbations: donor patching, which preserves a natural attention structure but decouples it from the text’s content, and permutation patching, which destroys the structure while preserving per-token weight distributions.
blocks.zh:
第2节中展示的线性叠加是反直观的. "变形器"的关键组件,尤其是其柔性最大非线性功能的自觉,旨在有选择地整合上下文. 人们预计两个无关的流(A和B)的注意模式会破坏性地干扰,导致混合代表制崩溃,形成一个与任何投入无关的状态。 然而,从经验来看,信号是活下来的。
这就提出了这样一个问题:注意力在促成这种线性性方面是否发挥作用,或者它是否是残余流在某种程度上绕过的障碍? 为了调查,我们设计了一个实验,将注意力的结构形状的影响从它的具体内容计算中分解出来。 我们比较我们的标准嵌入式混合设置与两个单流扰动:捐赠者补丁,它保留了自然的注意力结构,但将其与文本内容脱钩;以及穿透式补丁,它破坏结构,同时保留每根重量分布。

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the Qwen2.5-3B forward pass under embedding mixing and the two attention perturbations, broken down by token type. Across predictable positions, the vanilla top- ​ 1 \text{top-}1 token survives with a median rank of 3 3 – 6 6 under embedding mixing and donor patching, and exact agreement remains near 25 25 – 33 % 33\% . On content positions, however, these two setups diverge: embedding mixing yields a median rank of 284 284 , while donor patching drops to 111 111 . Permutation patching, by contrast, collapses entirely across both token types (median rank 3,079 3{,}079 on predictable, 19,246 19{,}246 on content), as it destroys the structural shape of attention. Two implications follow. First, the aggregate recovery numbers we reported in Sec. 2.2 are heavily weighted by the predictable majority of positions, where any perturbation that preserves the attention structure (and hence lets the LM-head frequency prior dominate) performs reasonably well. Second, the rank-survival on content positions specifically is what distinguishes the perturbations from each other.

blocks.en: Read as a self-agreement metric, donor patching looks remarkably benign: median rank 8 8 under wholesale substitution of every layer’s attention weights, R KL = 0.27 R_{\mathrm{KL}}=0.27 against the unrelated-text baseline. Read as a task-level metric, the same setup is catastrophic: on 200 200 LAMBADA prompts (left-truncated to 128 128 tokens, target rank measured at the final position), donor patching drives accuracy from the vanilla 73 % 73\% to 0.5 % \mathbf{0.5\%} , with the true target at median rank 2,350 2{,}350 . The two read-outs disagree because predictable and content positions disagree — LAMBADA targets are content words at the final position of long-narrative passages, exactly the regime where the predictable majority does not save us. The permutation control then dissociates two ingredients within donor patching itself. Permutation keeps the LM-head frequency prior intact (it does not touch Q/K/V or the LM head) but destroys the structural shape of attention; this raises R KL R_{\mathrm{KL}} from 0.27 0.27 to 0.68 0.68 , drops top- 10 10 agreement from 53 % 53\% to 10 % 10\% , and pushes median rank from 8 8 to 8,148 8{,}148 . The frequency prior alone is therefore not sufficient to keep aggregate metrics high. What survives donor patching is the joint contribution of two things: the frequency prior (dominating predictable positions) and the structural shape of natural attention — diagonal/locality bands, attention sinks, head specialization — properties that natural donor texts share with A A even when their content is unrelated. Neither alone is enough.
blocks.zh: 作为自我协议的衡量标准,捐赠者补丁看起来非常良性:中位数在每层注意力重量的批发替代下排名第8位,RKL=0.27 R_{\mathrm{KL}}=0.27 与不相关的文本基线相对应。 读作任务级的度量,相同的设置是灾难性的:在200个LAMBADA提示(左转至128个128个令牌,目标等级在最终位置测量)上,捐赠者补丁驱动精度从香草73 % 73%到0.5\ mathbf{0.5%,真实目标位居中位数2,350 2{,}350. 两种读出意见不一,因为可预见性和内容立场不一——LAMBADA指标是长篇叙述性段落最后位置的内容词,正是预测性多数不能拯救我们的制度. 穿透控制然后在捐赠者补丁中分离出两种成分。 Permutation使LM-head频率保持前置完整(它不触碰Q/K/V或LM头),但摧毁了注意的结构形状;这使RKL R_{\mathrm{KL}}从0.27 0.27降至0.68 0.68,将最高的10个协议从53% 53\%降至10% 10\%,并将中位排名从8推到8,148 8{,}148. 因此,仅靠先前的频率不足以使总的衡量标准保持高水平。 在捐助者补丁中幸存下来的是两件事的共同贡献:先发(支配可预见位置)的频率和自然注意力的结构形状——对角/局部波段、注意力汇、头部专门化——即使自然捐助者的文字内容不相关,它们也与AA分享。 单独一人是不够的。

blocks.en: On the same FineWeb-Edu pairs, embedding mixing has a worse aggregate self-agreement metric than donor patching (median 19 19 vs. 8 8 ). This is consistent with the model carrying two streams’ worth of information through the same residual stream rather than one rerouted stream: the natural baseline rank under perfect mixing is ∼ 1.5 \sim\!1.5 rather than 1 1 , and every layer’s Q/K/V is contaminated with both inputs from layer 0 0 , not only the attention weights. Yet on LAMBADA, where the predictable majority does not help, the order is reversed: embedding mixing reaches 2.25 % 2.25\% raw argmax accuracy with target median rank 339 339 , while donor patching reaches 0.5 % 0.5\% at median rank 2,350 2{,}350 — a 4.5 × \mathbf{4.5\times} accuracy gap and a 𝟕 × \mathbf{7\times} rank gap. Whatever the mixing setup carries on hard content positions, it is more than what survives donor patching, which is the LM-head prior plus structural attention. This places a non-trivial lower bound on what additive embedding composition has to preserve: it is enough to retain meaningfully more case-specific signal on hard content prediction than a wholesale donor-attention swap, while doing so simultaneously for two unrelated streams.

blocks.en: As we will show in Section 4 , the model can be fine-tuned to better support superposition. The dichotomy between predictable and content tokens clarifies exactly what this fine-tuning achieves. As seen in Table 2 , the base model’s aggregate median rank of 19 19 under embedding mixing is heavily buoyed by the predictable positions (median rank 6 6 )—its survival on actual content positions is very poor (median rank 284 284 ). However, after fine-tuning, the aggregate median rank improves to 6 6 . What is surprising here is how this happens: while predictable positions remain largely unchanged (median rank 8 8 ), the content positions see a massive restoration. Their median rank drops all the way to 5 5 , and exact top- ​ 1 \text{top-}1 agreement jumps to 22.8 % 22.8\% . The fine-tuned model is therefore no longer just leaning on the frequency prior; it is genuinely processing the semantic content of both streams in parallel.
blocks.zh: 正如我们将在第4节所显示的,这个模型可以进行微调,以便更好地支持叠加. 可预见和内容符号之间的二分法确切地澄清了这种微调的实现。 如表2所示,在嵌入式混合下,基准模型19 19 的总中位数由可预见位置(中间位置6 6)高度浮标——它在实际含量位置上的生存率很低(中间位置284 284 )。 然而,经过微调后,总中位数排名提高到6 6。 令人惊讶的是这种情况是如何发生的:虽然可以预测的立场基本上保持不变(中间排名8,8),但内容立场得到大规模恢复。 他们的中位排名一路下降到5 5, 准确的顶级- 1\ text{top}1协议跳跃到22.8% 22.8% 。 因此,经过微调的模型不再仅仅依靠先前的频率;它真正在平行处理两个流的语义内容.

blocks.en: 4 Improving Linearity with Finetuning
blocks.zh: 4 利用微调改进线性

blocks.en: As demonstrated in Sec. 2 , pre-trained Transformer models exhibit an intrinsic, albeit approximate, ability to process superposed inputs linearly. This property is present despite the standard pre-training objective not explicitly incentivizing such behavior. Here, we investigate whether this architectural capability can be enhanced through targeted optimization. We explore if a lightweight fine-tuning phase can align the model’s weights to explicitly support superposition.
blocks.zh: 如第2节所示,预先训练的变形器模型显示出一种内在的、尽管是近似的能力,可以线性地处理叠加输入。 尽管标准的培训前目标没有明确鼓励这种行为,但这种财产仍然存在。 在这里,我们调查是否可以通过有针对性的优化来加强这种建筑能力。 我们探索一个轻量级的微调阶段是否能够使模型的重量一致,明确支持叠加.

blocks.en: We employ a self-distillation framework designed to minimize the discrepancy between the model’s output on a mixed input and the mixture of its independent outputs. We initialize a student model M s ​ t ​ u ​ d ​ e ​ n ​ t M_{student} with pre-trained weights and use a frozen copy of the same model as the teacher M t ​ e ​ a ​ c ​ h ​ e ​ r M_{teacher} . For a pair of distinct text sequences x ( A ) x^{(A)} and x ( B ) x^{(B)} , we define the target probability distribution as the arithmetic mean of the teacher’s independent predictions: P t ​ a ​ r ​ g ​ e ​ t = 1 2 ​ ( M t ​ e ​ a ​ c ​ h ​ e ​ r ​ ( x ( A ) ) + M t ​ e ​ a ​ c ​ h ​ e ​ r ​ ( x ( B ) ) ) . P_{target}=\frac{1}{2}\left(M_{teacher}(x^{(A)})+M_{teacher}(x^{(B)})\right). (4) The student model processes the element-wise average of the input embeddings z = 1 2 ​ ( E ⁡ ( x ( A ) ) + E ⁡ ( x ( B ) ) ) z=\frac{1}{2}(E(x^{(A)})+E(x^{(B)})) . blocks.en: Sec. 4 showed that the mixed-input distribution can be brought close to its analytical target. A natural last question is whether one can then decode the two streams separately — which is what would turn the phenomenon into a parallel-inference primitive. We show that this is strictly harder than fitting the mixed distribution, and explain why.

blocks.en: While the probability mass of the target tokens is largely restored by fine-tuning, sampling directly from the mixed distribution creates semantically inconsistent sequences, as the model alternates between the tokens of context A A and context B B . In a linear superposition where the logits are approximately averaged, the resulting probabilities scale with the geometric mean of the independent distributions: P target ′ ​ ( t ) ∝ exp ⁡ ( 1 2 ​ ( ℓ A ​ ( t ) + ℓ B ​ ( t ) ) ) ∝ P A ​ ( t ) ​ P B ​ ( t ) . P^{\prime}_{\text{target}}(t)\;\propto\;\exp\!\bigl(\tfrac{1}{2}(\ell_{A}(t)+\ell_{B}(t))\bigr)\;\propto\;\sqrt{P_{A}(t)\,P_{B}(t)}. (6) This creates an intrinsic decoding challenge: any token that is highly probable in stream A A but highly unlikely in stream B B is heavily penalized by the geometric mean, pushing its mixed probability down. Thus, achieving rank 1 1 for both streams simultaneously using standard decoding is exceptionally difficult, even when both ground-truth tokens reliably appear in the top- ​ 5 \text{top-}5 (as achieved by fine-tuning). Consequently, to make superposition practically useful for parallel processing, we require a mechanism capable of disentangling the mixed hidden state back into its constituent streams. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we demonstrated that Transformers can process linearly combined text streams as a superposition of independent pathways. We showed that while this intrinsic architectural property degrades during standard pre-training, it can be robustly restored via lightweight fine-tuning, allowing the model to maintain distinct semantic signals within a mixed hidden state.
blocks.zh: 在这个作品中,我们证明了变形器可以将线性结合的文本流作为独立路径的叠加处理. 我们显示,虽然这种内在建筑属性在标准预训期间会退化,但可以通过轻量级微调进行强力还原,使模型能够在混合的隐蔽状态下保持明显的语义信号.

blocks.en: These findings have profound implications for efficient deployment. By successfully disentangling superposed outputs, our approach enables the generation of two coherent continuations from a single forward pass, theoretically offering a 𝟐 × \mathbf{2\times} increase in inference throughput. Furthermore, since multiple streams are compressed into a single vector representation, this paradigm drastically reduces memory consumption, effectively halving the KV-cache footprint per active stream.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果对高效部署具有深远影响。 通过成功解析叠加的产出,我们的方法能够从一个单一的前进通道产生两个连贯的延续,理论上提供2 × mathbf{2\times}增加推论量。 此外,由于多个流被压缩成单一的矢量表示,这个范式极大地减少了内存消耗,有效地将KV-cache脚印每活流减半.

blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Decoder-only Transformers exhibit surprisingly linear behavior in the residual stream: consecutive-layer mappings are often well-approximated by affine transforms ( Razzhigaev et al., 2024 ) . Closely related are methods that explicitly multiplex multiple inputs into a single representation and then demultiplex predictions, e.g., DataMUX ( Murahari et al., 2022 ) , binding/unbinding-based MIMONets ( Menet et al., 2023 ) , and RevMUX for efficient LLM batch inference via reversible adapters ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . At inference time, superposition is also exploited for parallel generation or context processing: Superposed Decoding mixes draft token embeddings to produce multiple continuations in one autoregressive pass ( Shen et al., 2024 ) , while superposition prompting accelerates RAG by processing multiple document paths within a single forward pass ( Merth et al., 2024 ) . Complementary perspectives include task superposition in in-context learning ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) and feature superposition as a representational bottleneck ( Elhage and others, 2022 ) . In contrast to approaches that add mux/demux structure, we isolate an intrinsic input–output superposition effect in standard pretrained LLMs under linear embedding mixing, track its degradation during pretraining, and show it can be restored by lightweight finetuning and partially disentangled at decoding time. Concretely, prior multiplexing methods (DataMUX, MIMONets, RevMUX) treat superposition as an engineered capability that must be externally imposed via dedicated layers, VSA-style binding/unbinding keys, or isometry regularization. Our claim is qualitatively different: superposition is intrinsic to standard pretrained Transformers, simple embedding averaging in off-the-shelf LLMs already preserves substantial signal, and our lightweight fine-tuning restores a property that pretraining has degraded rather than creating a new one.
blocks.zh: 只有解码器的变形器在残流中展现出令人惊讶的线性行为:连续层的映射往往与affine变形非常近似(Razzigaev等人,2024年). 密切相关的方法是明确将多倍输入输入一个单一的表示,然后进行多倍预测的方法,例如DataMUX(Murahari等人,2022年),装订/不装订的MIMONets(Menet等人,2023年)和RevMUX,通过可逆适配器高效进行LLM批量推断(Xu等人,2024年)。 在推论时间,叠加还被用于平行生成或上下文处理: 叠加的解码器混合了草稿令牌嵌入器,以产生一个自动递归通道(Shen等人,2024年)中的多个续作(Shen等人,2024年),而叠加器则通过在单个前进通道内处理多个文件路径(Merth等人,2024年)来加速RAG. 补充视角包括在内容内学习中的任务叠加(Xiong等人,2024年),并将叠加作为代表瓶颈(Elhage等人,2022年)的特点. 与添加 mux/demux 结构的方法相反,我们在线性嵌入混合下,在标准预试LLMs中分离出内在的输入-输出叠加效应,跟踪其在预试过程中的降解,并显示可以通过轻量级微调恢复,并在解码时部分分解. 具体地说,先前的多轴方法(DataMUX、MIMONets、RevMUX)将叠加视为一种工程能力,必须通过专用层、VSA式绑定/无绑定键或同位素规范等外部施加。 我们的说法在质量上是不同的:叠加是标准预先训练的变形器的内在,简单的嵌入平均在现成的LLMs中已经保存了大量的信号,我们的轻量级微调还原了一种预先训练已经退化而不是创造新的财产.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Our study establishes the existence and recoverability of linear superposition in Transformer language models, but several boundaries of this phenomenon remain to be explored:
blocks.zh: 我们的研究确定了变形器语言模型中线性叠加的存在和可恢复性,但这一现象的若干界限仍有待探索:

blocks.en: • Context length and language: Our evaluations utilized relatively short-context ( L ≤ 128 L\leq 128 for analytical experiments, with extensions to L = 512 L=512 in Sec. 2.3 ) and predominantly monolingual text corpora. Generalizing this approach to substantially longer contexts or multilingual settings involves more complex embedding geometries, presenting an important avenue for future work. • Multimodal models: Our investigation focuses exclusively on text-based language models. We have not tested whether these linear superposition properties extend to multimodal architectures. Mixing embeddings from intrinsically different modalities (e.g., combining text tokens with image patches) poses distinct structural and geometric challenges for the residual stream that remain completely unexplored.
blocks.zh: • 背景长度和语言: 我们的评价使用相对短的文字(L 128 L\leq 128)进行分析试验,扩展为L = 512 L=512 Sec. 2.3),并主要使用单一语言文字corpora。 将这一办法推广到较长的环境或多语种环境中,涉及更复杂的嵌入地理美图,为今后的工作提供了重要途径。 • 多式联运模式: 我们的调查完全集中于文字语言模式。 我们尚未测试这些线性叠加特性是否延伸到多式联运结构。 从内在不同的模式(如将文本符号与图像补丁相结合)混合嵌入对仍然完全未探索的剩余流构成不同的结构和几何挑战.

blocks.en: Appendix L Impact Statement

blocks.en: Our findings can directly improve the scalability and accessibility of large language models by increasing throughput and lowering infrastructure costs. This may benefit applications requiring high-volume or real-time language generation, such as chatbots and large-scale retrieval-augmented systems.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果能够通过增加吞吐量和降低基础设施成本,直接提高大型语言模型的可扩展性和可获取性。 这可能有利于需要高容量或实时语言生成的应用程序,如聊天机和大规模检索增强系统.

blocks.en: We recognize that parallel processing techniques could also introduce new risks if misapplied, for example by inadvertently mixing unrelated or sensitive streams. Careful validation and monitoring will be important in downstream systems. Overall, this work contributes to the responsible advancement of efficient language modeling and opens new directions for model design that exploit intrinsic architectural properties.
blocks.zh: 我们认识到,如果应用不当,平行处理技术也可能带来新的风险,例如无意中混合了无关的或敏感的流。 在下游系统中,认真的验证和监测将十分重要。 总体而言,这项工作有助于负责任地推进高效的语言建模,并为利用内在建筑特性的模型设计开辟了新的方向.
